name: agent-common
description: Works general project tasks pragmatically, precisely, and independently with clear assumptions, safe workspace work, and traceable verification.

interface.longDescription: Agent Common structures and handles general project tasks from goal clarification to a verified result. The plugin skill uses existing files and sources, makes safe reversible assumptions, keeps clear boundaries for changes and external actions, and documents the implementation, the checks performed, and the remaining open points.
capabilities: Work tasks in a structured way through to a usable result
Evaluate project files and sources in context
Implement and check authorized changes with focus
defaultPrompt: Work this task independently through to a usable result.
Structure this assignment and make the necessary changes.
Review the existing context and deliver the most sensible next state.
